implementation_summary.useApi_hook: Generic API call hook with loading states, error handling, retry logic with exponential backoff, request cancellation support, and convenience hooks for each HTTP method
implementation_summary.useAsyncData_hook: React Query-like data fetching with loading/error/success states, automatic refetching on window focus, optimistic updates, infinite queries, and pagination support
implementation_summary.mockApiClient: Realistic API simulation with 100-500ms response times, 5% failure rate, caching mechanism, and consistent data across calls for all endpoints
implementation_summary.api_types: Comprehensive TypeScript interfaces for requests/responses, error types, generic API wrapper, and strict mode compliance
implementation_summary.api_context: Global API configuration with online/offline detection, global loading/error states, and provider pattern
